## Highlights
### New
- Move a whole folder, with everything in it, to another Space from its menu.
### Improved
- The line between saved and open tabs now runs up to Clear, instead of stopping well short of it. - Texture is now its own setting for every Space, from none to full, in every customization style, and it shows over banner and solid sidebars as well as gradients. Modern's gradient direction is set on a dial again. - The selected tab now wears the same glass as the address field and pins, and stands out more over dark sidebars. - Split Views in the sidebar now look and work like folders: their tabs are indented, a click collapses or expands them, and a double click renames them. The chevron of a collapsed Split View, folder or Space turns as it opens and closes, and their titles no longer flash. - A closed folder keeps every loaded tab listed under it, and they stay, even once they unload, until you open and close the folder again. - Deleting a folder now deletes everything inside it, after asking first, and its tabs go to the Archive.
### Fixed
- Choosing Modern's custom gradient now shows its two colors under the color sets, and picking them works, instead of a popover the color picker closed. - Opening or closing a folder that holds the tab you're on no longer makes that tab jump through the folder's title.
---

## Highlights
### Fixed
- Downloads follow the Automatic Downloads choice of the site you’re on, including files it serves from another address, such as GitHub release files. A blocked download’s message no longer appears twice. - Chromium pages use your default zoom when they open and keep your chosen zoom as you navigate. - Chromium is updated to 154.0.8037.57 with upstream security and compatibility fixes.
